cards.title: Amtgard Food Fight
cards.blurb:
Amtgard Food Fight is a month-long fundraising and service event that is celebrated in every Kingdom of our game. We come together and fight hunger in our local communities every September and naturally to compete amongst ourselves to see which Kingdom can do the most good.

Contact the Food Fight Team: communityoutreach@amtgard.com

cards.title: Amtgard Spring Muster
cards.blurb:
Spring Muster is a recruitment event that spans from 1 to 3 months. The purpose is to not only recruit new players with a competition between the Kingdoms, but also to revitalize engagement and retention of our existing players and offer some other programming to make our game a better place.

Contact the Spring Muster Team: Muster@amtgard.com

Page Coming Soon

cards.title: Olympiad
cards.blurb:
An annual Tourney that tests the best of the best in Arts and Sciences as well as War skills. Hosting of Olympiad rotates among all the Kingdoms. The winner of the War skills is called the War Olympian, the winner of the Arts and Sciences tourney is called the Cultural Olympian, and the overall winner is the Grand Olympian.

Contact the Olympiad Team: olympiad@amtgard.com
